projects.title: Sparse autoencoders on attention outputs of a small model

projects.title: Emergent misalignment above 32B parameters, and what it travels with

projects.title: A longer, messier research-engineering task for agents

projects.title: A worked guaranteed-safe-AI specification for one small domain

gap.q: A limitation of classical automated planners is that they operate over deterministic world models which only admit Boolean variables.

projects.sum: Model a control evaluation as a game between red and blue teams and derive when a model's ability to resist training changes the safety estimate.

A sketch of a control safety case.

gap.q: Future work could model the case where we use discrimination as an analogy for training, but we don’t assume that models can’t exploration hack

projects.title: How do people decide whether a chatbot's answer in their own field is right?
projects.sum: Watch 12 to 20 professionals check chatbot answers in their field while thinking aloud, and code the cues they use.

start.note: Studies how intuition shapes reliance on AI advice with explanations; calls for work on what people treat as evidence.

gap.q: We encourage future work to first explore what people consider to be evidence to discredit predictions for different types of explanations

projects.title: How much does the time-horizon trend depend on analysis choices?
